verdict.rationale: Composio exposes meta-tools that let agents discover toolkits/tools at runtime (composio-docs-2, composio-docs-14), plus a documented OpenAPI spec (composio-probe-2) and llms.txt for programmatic discovery (composio-probe-1), alongside MCP-based catalog access (composio-docs-26, composio-docs-4). This directly supports an AI agent programmatically querying the registry/catalog via documented APIs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of registry query results (only vendor docs and probes cited), and no explicit example of a raw REST 'list tools/servers' endpoint call shown end-to-end.
